notes.title: [Dev Diary #33] Gabi’s Motion Matching Part 2 – Perfecting Stealth Movement
notes.notes:
[p]In this week’s Dev Diary #33, we present the second part of Gabi’s Motion Matching development. 🎬
With Velocity Direction-based walking and turning, along with the core of stealth gameplay – Look-at Direction Crouch Walking – implemented in various steps, we are perfecting smooth and tense stealth movements. 🕵️‍♀️[/p][p]This work aims to create movements that reflect the player’s intentions and situations, not just simple locomotion animations. 🎯
Look forward to the strategies and emotions that each of Gabi’s steps will bring in the future. 🚀[/p][previewyoutube="lyYAYNA3FD4;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: YOU DIED: Contextual Death Animations in Mudang: Two Hearts
notes.notes:
[p]🩸【Dev Diary Alert】
We told you to move quietly. But you didn’t listen, did you?[/p][p]This week’s Mudang: Two Hearts Dev Diary pulls the curtain back on what happens when you charge in guns blazing: brutal, context-sensitive executions designed to make you feel every mistake.[/p][p]🔫 Let your guard down, and a shadowy soldier ends you in a blink.
📣 Trigger an alarm, and you're shredded within seconds.[/p][p]These aren’t just deaths.
They’re part of the story.[/p][p]⚠️Want to survive? Move with caution.
If not… one of these deaths might be waiting for you.[/p][p]🎥 Watch now and witness a battlefield where even death tells a tale.[/p][p]#MudangTwoHearts #DevDiary #YouDied #ExecutionKills #StealthOrDie[/p][previewyoutube="vu_9dmf8-p8;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Dev Diary #30: Throwing Knife for Mudang: Two Hearts is now live!
notes.notes:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="dCeEVgSM2mo;full"][/previewyoutube][p]🎯 [b]Dev Diary #31 – Stealth Tactics: Throwing Knives[/b][/p][p]Deep behind enemy lines—too far to execute a takedown, too close to fire a shot without giving away your position.
In moments like this, there’s a silent but deadly option: [b]the throwing knife[/b].[/p][p]Throwing knives aren’t just backup tools.
💥 They’re perfect for [b]silent assassinations[/b]
⚔️ A deadly extension of your [b]close-quarters combat[/b]
🧠 And a [b]tactical answer to outnumbered encounters[/b].[/p][p]You can wield them up close, or throw them to stagger enemies at a distance by putting them into a [b]groggy state[/b].
Used wisely, they give you the edge—even against multiple hostiles.[/p][p]🕶️ Quiet. Precise. Lethal.
And ultimately, it all comes down to [b]your control[/b].[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p]

notes.title: 🔥 “The World Reacts!” A Compilation of YouTubers’ Epic Reactions to the MUDANG
notes.notes: [p][/p][previewyoutube="JjrTeWOWYEk;full"][/previewyoutube][p]We’ve gathered some of the most passionate and explosive reactions from content creators around the world to the trailer for [b]MUDANG: Two Hearts[/b].[/p][p]This episode of our Dev Diary captures one of the most emotional moments for our team. Countless creators responded to the trailer with genuine excitement, and their enthusiasm has been a huge source of strength and inspiration for us.[/p][p]🎥 Through this video, we invite you to feel how [i]MUDANG[/i] is resonating with gamers across the globe.[/p][p]From the bottom of our hearts, [b]thank you to all the amazing YouTubers and creators worldwide.[/b] Your voices are making the journey of [i]MUDANG[/i] even stronger. We’re listening. And we’re building. 🎮[/p]

notes.title: Presenting the development journey of MUDANG: Two Hearts!
notes.notes:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="KBqUFKykw60;full"][/previewyoutube][p][b]Presenting the development journey of MUDANG: Two Hearts![/b]
[b]Dev Diary #29[/b]
[b]Community Feedback Session: Rifle Sling[/b][/p][p][b]"If you want it — we make it!"[/b][/p][p]Why?
Because our mission is to create the game [i]you truly want to play[/i].[/p][p]In this 29th episode of our Dev Diary, we’re introducing a feature many of you have been asking for: the [b]Rifle Sling[/b].
Thanks to your consistent feedback, we realized how important this was —
and after many rounds of internal discussion, the dev team decided to implement it.[/p][p]While it’s not yet a fully developed sling system,
we’ve added a functional sling setup to all standard rifles (excluding special weapons)
to enhance immersion and realism in gameplay.
Today, we’re excited to share the results with you.[/p][p]This journey isn’t something we build alone —
it’s a collaborative creation [i]with all of you[/i].[/p][p]So please continue to send us your honest and sharp feedback.
We’re listening. And we’re building. 🎮🔥[/p][p]You can find more development updates on the official MUDANG: Two Hearts Dev Diary channel!
[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/@MUDANG-EVR"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]
